messages:
jess: Kicking off warm-wait for the green pool — holding at 10% for 5m. Checkpoints: health, 95th latency, error-rate.

sam: ack. I'll watch latency dashboards and traces.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: router-weight-shift -> green 10% at 2025-08-12 18:11 UTC (initiated by jess). Command: `routerctl shift --to green --percent 10` :robot_face:

priya: warm pods report READY, image v2.8.1. No crashloop.

matt: session affinity bindings look consistent, no session loss during warm attach.

sam: seeing a small p99 bump (+30ms) around 18:13 but still within SLO.

jess: holding through the 5m checkpoint. If error-rate > 0.5% or 95th latency +100ms => rollback. Otherwise proceed to 25% in 10m.

ops-bot: alert rule armed: `router_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 3m` -> auto-rollback hook ready.

deploy-bot: shift executed -> green 10% :white_check_mark: (18:11 UTC)

priya: running smoke: `/health` 200, `/api/chat` simple prompt returns expected tokens.

matt: noticing a brief spike in gateway 502s from edge-pool-7 at 18:15, correlating to green traffic.

sam: digging traces, looks like an ENV mismatch (FEATURE_FLAG_CHATV2 not present in green env). 502s originate at edge7 -> upstream 502.

jess: ok. trigger rollback plan: pin traffic back to blue and mark green nodes quarantined. Also pin router version to v2.8.1 until follow-up. matt, execute rollback command: `routerctl shift --to blue --percent 100 --force`.

matt: executing rollback command now.

deploy-bot: shift executed -> blue 100% :rotating_light: (18:18 UTC)

priya: starting config revert on green nodes and collecting `env` diffs. Will create a gated patch and re-run warm-wait after validations.

jess: filing a short post-action: "aborted green rollout due to env var mismatch causing edge pool 502s; rollback to blue; green quarantined; will revalidate envs and re-run warm-wait". Linking issue: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2345

sam: +1. Recommend a 15m quiet window and a preflight that includes `env` diff across blue/green, smoke on edge7 specifically, and a synthetic load test to cover p99 tails.

jess: agreed. We'll reschedule a new warm-wait attempt after the patch. Thanks y'all :heart:
